name: Dermatitis Herpetiformis

criteria.description: Chronic, intensely pruritic grouped papulovesicular eruption on extensor surfaces
Granular IgA deposits in dermal papillae on direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin
Evidence of gluten sensitivity or celiac disease (serologic or histologic)
Subepidermal blister with neutrophilic microabscesses in dermal papillae

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic clinical lesions plus granular IgA deposits on direct immunofluorescence
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Serologic tests for anti-tissue transglutaminase and anti-endomysial antibodies support diagnosis

pathognomonic.symptomName: Grouped pruritic papulovesicles on extensor surfaces
searchTerms: itchy grouped blisters on arms and legs
pruritic papules and vesicles on extensor surfaces
clustered itchy bumps on elbows and knees

pathognomonic.symptomName: Granular IgA deposits in dermal papillae
searchTerms: immune complex buildup in skin papillae

common.symptomName: Symmetric distribution of lesions on elbows and knees
searchTerms: symmetrical skin lesions on elbows and knees

common.symptomName: Excoriations and crusting secondary to scratching
searchTerms: scratched skin with crusts and sores
excoriated and crusted skin from itching

common.symptomName: Associated gluten-sensitive enteropathy symptoms (e.g. diarrhea, bloating)
searchTerms: gluten intolerance symptoms like diarrhea and bloating
digestive issues linked to gluten sensitivity

occasional.symptomName: Lesions on scalp, buttocks, or back
searchTerms: skin lesions on scalp, buttocks, or back
bumps or rashes on common areas
skin spots on head and lower back
mild anemia from poor nutrient absorption
low blood count due to malabsorption

occasional.symptomName: Fatigue due to associated celiac disease

searchTerms: weight loss from poor nutrient absorption

other: Direct immunofluorescence showing granular IgA deposits in dermal papillae
Skin biopsy with subepidermal blister and neutrophilic microabscesses

distinguishingFeatures: Linear IgG and C3 deposits on basement membrane zone
Linear IgG deposits along basement membrane

redFlags: Signs of malnutrition or severe malabsorption
Neurological symptoms suggestive of peripheral neuropathy
